description: Nishat Chunian Power Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan on 23 February 2007 as a power generation project commissioned under the Government of Pakistan's 2002 Power Policy. It builds, owns, operates and maintains a fuel-fired power station with a gross capacity of 200 MW and a net capacity of 195.722 MW — an RFO-fired reciprocating engine combined cycle plant using 11 Wartsila 18V46 engine sets and one heat recovery steam turbine. It sells its output to Central Power Purchasing Agency (Guarantee) Limited under a 25-year power purchase agreement that commenced on 21 July 2010, with commercial operations from July 2010.

products.name: RFO-fired combined cycle power generation
products.summary: A 200 MW gross (195.722 MW net) residual furnace oil-fired reciprocating engine combined cycle plant, comprising 11 Wartsila 18V46 engine sets and one heat recovery steam turbine with Converteam and ABB alternators.

products.name: Power sold under a 25-year PPA
products.summary: Electricity supplied to the company's sole customer, Central Power Purchasing Agency (Guarantee) Limited, under a power purchase agreement that commenced on 21 July 2010.
